description: CREATE TABLE core-semantics acceptance on postgresql17 (#119): column/constraint/identity/partition/temporary/LIKE/AS shapes execute natively; every inventory shape pins its audit answer.

ddl_steps.name: create table core
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t36.users (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, email text NOT NULL, created timestamptz DEFAULT now())

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='t36' AND table_name='users_as'

setup.name: create owned generation schema
setup.sql: CREATE SCHEMA pgg36_pos;CREATE SEQUENCE pgg36_pos.audit_guard START 7

post_verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='pgg36_pos'

post_verify.assert: audit does not advance sentinel sequence

execute.name: native CREATE declarations only, no INSERT or nextval
execute.sql: CREATE TABLE pgg36_pos.g1(id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY(START 2147483648 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 NO CYCLE), code bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS (id * 2) STORED);CREATE TABLE pgg36_pos.g2(id smallint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY(MAXVALUE 10 CYCLE));

structure.sql: SELECT string_agg(c.relname || '.' || a.attname || ':' || a.attidentity::text || ':' || a.attgenerated::text, ',' ORDER BY c.relname,a.attname) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='pgg36_pos' AND c.relname IN ('g1','g2') AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped

structure.assert: native full int64 bound retained and no cycling
structure.sql: SELECT seqstart::text || ':' || seqmax::text || ':' || seqcycle::text FROM pg_sequence WHERE seqrelid='pgg36_pos.g1_id_seq'::regclass
SELECT seqmax::text || ':' || seqcycle::text FROM pg_sequence WHERE seqrelid='pgg36_pos.g2_id_seq'::regclass
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pgg36_pos.g1)::text || ':' || (SELECT count(*) FROM pgg36_pos.g2)::text

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='pgg36_pos'
